newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary electricity prices to rise 3.6 pct April 1.
newsitem.headline: Hungary electricity prices to rise 3.6 pct April 1.

text.p: Hungary's Ministry of Industry and Trade said on Friday Hungarian electricity retail prices will rise by 3.6 percent from April 1.
"The April rise covers the devaluation of the forint," ministry spokeswoman Klara Fogarasi said.
Under the central bank's crawling peg devaluation system, the forint is devalued by 1.2 percent per month against a central bank currency basket. The rate will fall to 1.1 percent from April 1.
Head of the the ministry's energy department Pal Ligeti told Reuters negotiations with the energy companies on future prices rises were continuing.

"The April price rise has been decided but talks with the energy distribution companies are continuing over concerns they expressed to us (this) March," he said. "Any resultant price adjustments will be incorporated into June or September rises."
The April 1 increase is the first stemming from a new system in which electricity prices are adjusted quarterly.
